name: William Hope Spirit Photograph, 1919
description: A photograph by William Hope presented as showing Mr and Mrs Gibson with the supposed spirit of their deceased son. The archive identifies Hope as a paranormal hoaxer.

name: William Hope Group Spirit Photograph, 1922
description: A group photograph from a meeting of the Society for the Study of Supernormal Pictures, with a supposed spirit appearing in front.

name: William Hope Leverson Spirit Photograph, 1931
description: An alleged spirit photograph showing Mrs Hortense Leverson with what was claimed to be the spirit of her deceased husband.

name: Mrs Longcake Spirit Photograph
description: A William Hope photograph presented as showing Mrs Longcake beside the supposed spirit of her deceased sister-in-law.

name: Plague Doctor Engraving
description: A nineteenth-century plague-doctor image published in The Mirror of Literature, Amusement, and Instruction.

name: Danse Macabre, 1922
description: A surviving image connected to the 1922 silent film Danse Macabre.
